# ANALYSIS: Real-Fills Verification Plan

**Filed:** 2026-09-07  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** analysis  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We intend to verify the real-fills of the current engine over the last 30 days using OPRA tick data and compare to the paper simulation (BS-sim) to ensure the simulator is within ±20% of real fills on the top-3 anchor days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) and does not introduce significant bias on loser days.

## Mechanism

We will run the current engine (as defined in the current params.json and heartbeat.md) over the last 30 days of OPRA tick data, recording the actual fills (using bid/ask spread and a slippage model of 10% of spread) and compare the P&L on each of the J anchor days and the overall P&L to the paper simulation (BS-sim) run over the same period. We will use the OPRA cache at `backtest/data/options/` and fill missing dates via `tools/expand_opra_cache.py`.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** We will use the current account size assumption from params.json (Safe and Bold) for the verification. We assume the account size is sufficient to trade the quantity used in the engine (min 3 contracts). For the purpose of this verification, we will use the engine's current contract sizing.
2. **Sample bias:** We will use the last 30 days of OPRA tick data. This is a fixed sample and may be subject to regime bias. We will note the sample size and the date range.
3. **Out-of-sample:** This verification is not an OOS test for a strategy change; it is a validation of the simulator. We will not compute an OOS ratio. Instead, we will compare the real-fills to the paper simulation on the same in-sample period (the last 30 days). We will label this as NEEDS-OOS for the purpose of the strategy candidate if we were to propose one, but for this verification we are only comparing simulation to real.
4. **Real-fills:** This is the real-fills verification. We will be using OPRA tick data to simulate real fills. We will label this as DONE after we run it, but until then we have not run it.
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - If the real-fills differ from the paper simulation by more than ±20% on any of the anchor days, we will flag a failure.
   - If the OPRA data is incomplete for any day in the last 30 days, we will note the missing data.
   - If the slippage model is inadequate, we may still see discrepancies.
6. **Concentration:** We will compute the concentration of P&L in the top 5 days for both the real-fills and the paper simulation and disclose the percentage.

## Pre-merge gate

We will need to run the verification and then check:
   - The real-fills vs paper simulation on the anchor days is within ±20%.
   - The overall P&L of real-fills is not catastrophically worse than the paper simulation (we will define a threshold, e.g., not more than 50% worse).
